issue: worktree of the recipe branch is 88 commits ahead of the prebuilt main, and had no submodules
fix: git submodule update --init --recursive, then a full Release rebuild in the worktree

issue: rope donor gpt_oss_d_p/tt/rope.py implements YaRN; Llama 3.1 uses llama3 smooth-ramp scaling with no mscale
fix: wrote llama3_inv_freq fresh and pinned it against transformers ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS['llama3']

issue: spec v0 rope block cannot express llama3 scaling: it needs low_freq_factor and high_freq_factor, not beta_fast/beta_slow
fix: took the two factors from the vendored config.json and recorded the gap in docs/SPEC_NOTES.md

issue: recipe fixes per-chip cache shape dim1 at literal 1, true only when TP == n_kv_heads; Llama has 8 KV heads at TP=4
fix: allocate_kv_cache takes num_kv_heads_local = n_kv_heads // tp (2 here) and asserts it against the write

why: Llama has no QK-norm (spec attention.features is empty)
dense model: no MoE router to test

issue: multi-chunk block-cyclic cache read-back gave PCC 0.06: row-concatenation is natural order only for a single chunk
fix: added block_cyclic_to_natural using the writer map g(c,lr)=(lr//C)*sp*C + c*C + lr%C

issue: mixing fabric configs or mesh shapes in one pytest process kills fabric bring-up with a misleading ethernet-handshake timeout
fix: run_bringup.sh runs one group per fabric config and mesh shape

why: a 4-chip submesh of this plain-MESH Galaxy cannot train its fabric links; TP-without-SP is not a spec target

issue: gpt_oss MeshConfig has no reduce_scatter, which minimax's 2D vocab-parallel embedding calls to sum per-row lookups across SP
fix: added MeshConfig.reduce_scatter from the minimax donor; both embedding modes then reach PCC 1.0

issue: recipe DoD requires bringup_digest.py --lint but common/prefill/tools/ does not exist in the repo
fix: wrote models/demos/common/prefill/tools/bringup_digest.py to the spec in recipe sections 7.5-7.6

issue: bf8->bf8 ttnn.copy re-quantizes, so allocate-then-copy leaves a second quantization and the bit-exact table check fails
fix: build the populated cache with from_torch at the allocator's memory config and compare the table read against ttnn's own read-back

issue: adapter model_config contract is stated as 'FABRIC_PAYLOAD_SIZE, etc.'; the engine also reads HEAD_DIM, NUM_KEY_VALUE_HEADS and ROTARY_DIM
fix: added the SCREAMING_CASE contract attributes to Llama31_8BConfig and documented the real set

issue: prefill_runner defaults PREFILL_NUM_LAYERS to 61 (DeepSeek's depth), so an unset model silently builds the wrong layer count
fix: pinned PREFILL_NUM_LAYERS=32 in the model manifest

issue: LayerAck channel is a counter drained by the reader, not a per-layer message; my set_layer_ack_channel called ack(layer_idx)
fix: bump it with inject(1) per completed layer, as the gpt_oss donor does, and require compile() first

issue: runner passes metadata_msg to prefill_chunk; the runtime contract documents only request_id, and neither GQA donor accepts it
fix: accept metadata_msg (and d2h_service/record_dev) and ignore them: a single pipeline stage forwards nothing

issue: producer waited for 244=61x4 layer acks while the 32-layer model sent 128: it ignores PREFILL_MANIFEST and reads NUM_LAYERS from env
fix: export PREFILL_NUM_LAYERS=32 in the serving script so both processes agree, not just the manifest

issue: at the spec's own numerics (bfp8 attn + bfp4 mlp) end-to-end per-layer KV is K=0.9938 V=0.9677, under acceptance.per_layer_kv 0.99
fix: recorded both dtype regimes in README; the e2e_chunked 0.93 gate passes, per_layer_kv 0.99 needs bf16 weights
